|}<noinclude>==Usage==
This template is used to ask a contributor to go to a particular talk page to join a discussion.

==Parameters==
The template has two parameters that must be used. The first parameter is the talk page. Be sure to include "Talk" in the parameter. The second parameter is the name of the user leaving the message.

<nowiki>{{Request|Talk:A beginning|Mainphramephreak}}</nowiki> produces:

{{request|Talk:A beginning|Mainphramephreak}}
